purpose: portable, non-sensitive provenance for committed Stage G reports

excluded.reason: downloaded third-party webpage payloads and runtime cache
per-task runtime files are represented by the final dossier and public Trace
canonical reports are maintained under docs/acceptance
raw execution Trace remains local; public_trace.jsonl is the committed observable projection

limitations: Raw snapshot payloads are not included, so character-range locator checks cannot be replayed offline.
Historical snapshot IDs, raw_ref values, and raw Trace references remain in structured records to preserve provenance identity.
External source URLs remain the authoritative location for third-party content.
